title: Gurpreet Kaur v. Ram Lal Sharma
text: The landlady, Gurpreet Kaur, filed an eviction petition under the Punjab Rent Act against the tenant, Ram Lal Sharma. The ground of eviction is subletting without prior written consent of the landlady and non-payment of arrears of rent. The tenancy was created under a registered deed for residential purposes. The tenant sublet the premises to a third party while continuing to reside elsewhere. This constitutes a ground for eviction under the Rent Control Act. The tenant denied subletting and claimed to be a protected tenant. The court inspected the premises and found third parties in occupation. Arrears of rent for 20 months were also proved through bank statements and demand notices. The court grants the eviction decree. The landlady is entitled to possession. The tenant is directed to clear arrears of rent within 30 days.
